name: writing-skills
description: Writing registers and explanation craft: adams-smart-brevity (Adams + Axios Smart Brevity for professional, technical, legal, and clinical writing, with the risk-allocation carve-outs and the where-the-bar-disagrees register), adams-plain-grade (5th-8th grade accessible register with the discretion/obligation check), explanation-design (audience models, break-point-marked analogies, the Feynman loop, teach-back), and technical-documentation (Diataxis routing, ADRs, and the owner/cadence/last-verified discipline that keeps a page true).
